sentences.text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling achieved a WER of 6.4% with 4.0 decoder passes and a median latency of 41 ms, whereas Talmar achieved a slightly lower WER of 6.1% but required 37.6 decoder passes and a median latency of 118 ms.

Brisling was about 2.9 times faster than Talmar in median latency, but this comparison is confounded by different hardware and precision settings: Talmar's latency was measured on a Corvex A1 accelerator in fp32, while Brisling's was measured on a Corvex A2 accelerator in fp16.
No statistical tests were reported, so the observed differences in WER and latency cannot be interpreted as statistically significant.
